documents.title: CET1 12.7% at June 2026; OCR 13.51%
documents.excerpt: CET1 capital of £396.7M on £3,124M of risk-weighted assets gives 12.7% (13.2% at December 2025). Total capital ratio 16.7% against an overall capital requirement of 13.51%; leverage ratio 7.5%.

documents.title: NIM down to 4.2% as Bank Rate cuts reprice the variable book
documents.excerpt: Gross income margin fell to 9.8% (2024: 10.7%) as lower base rates affected variable-rate loans; blended cost of funds improved only to 4.3% with slower repricing of deposits. NIM 4.2% (2024: 4.5%).

documents.title: Loan book +30% to £4.66Bn; deposits +15.6% to £5.23Bn
documents.excerpt: Specialist Mortgages +34.7% to £3.22Bn, Development Finance +65% to £602M, Wholesale Finance +57% to £547M; new lending £1.91Bn (+21%). Loan-to-deposit ratio 89.1%.

documents.title: Development finance stage 2 up to 16.4% (synthetic)
documents.excerpt: Four South East & East schemes (£52M) moved to stage 2 after slower unit sales and 9% higher build costs. FY2026 cost of risk forecast 30 bps vs 15 bps plan.

documents.title: £640M fixed-term bond maturity wave Dec-26 to Feb-27 (synthetic)
documents.excerpt: 27% of the £2.35Bn bond book matures in three months at an average 4.85%. Retention averaged 78% in 2026 against 85% in the plan; pricing decision needed for the December cohort.
